content: The miscellaneous hazardous materials category, classified under HAZMAT Class 9, includes all hazardous materials that do not conform to the definitions outlined in Classes 1 through 8. A miscellaneous hazardous material is defined as a substance that poses a risk during transportation but does not meet the criteria for any other hazard class. This category may include materials such as elevated temperature substances, hazardous substances, hazardous waste, or marine pollutants.
